establishment_regulation_required.quote: In addition to any other duties prescribed by law, the Health Licensing Office shall provide for the inspection of facilities.

definition_quote.value: Cosmetology means the art or science of beautifying and improving the skin, nails and hair and the study of cosmetics and their application.
definition_quote.quote: "Cosmetology" means the art or science of beautifying and improving the skin, nails and hair and the study of cosmetics and their application.

value: Hair design (styling, cutting, coloring, shampooing, permanent waving, relaxing, bleaching, conditioning)
Barbering (shampooing, styling, cutting, shaving, scalp/face/neck massage)
Esthetics (skin care, facial treatments, hair removal, makeup artistry, eyebrow/eyelash services)
Natural hair care (braiding, cornrowing, locking, weaving, extending, twisting, wrapping)
methods_authorized.quote: "Field of practice" means the following cosmetology disciplines: (a) Barbering. (b) Esthetics. (c) Hair design. (d) Nail technology. (e) Natural hair care.

license_tiers.quote: "Certificate" means a written authorization for the holder to perform in one or more fields of practice. ... "Freelance license" means a written authorization that allows a practitioner to practice outside or away from a licensed facility. ... "License" means a written authorization issued under ORS 690.055 to a person to operate a facility or freelance business ... "Registration" means a written authorization issued to an independent contractor to hold forth to the public as a business entity providing services in a field of practice.

specialty_practice_areas.quote: "Field of practice" means the following cosmetology disciplines: (a) Barbering. (b) Esthetics. (c) Hair design. (d) Nail technology. (e) Natural hair care.

natural_hair_braiding_exempt.quote: "Natural hair care" means: (A) The braiding, cornrowing, extending, lacing, locking, sewing, twisting, weaving or wrapping of human hair

apprenticeship_available.quote: The Board of Cosmetology shall adopt rules to allow an individual who holds a provisional certificate issued under this section to perform in a field of practice under the supervision of a practitioner who holds a certificate in the same field of practice

mobile_or_home_service_permitted.quote: The Health Licensing Office may issue a practitioner a freelance license to practice outside or away from a licensed facility.

temporary_license_available.quote: "Demonstration permit" means a written authorization for a person to practice, demonstrate and teach one or more fields of practice on a temporary basis.

temporary_license_duration_months.quote: The period during which the person is permitted to practice, demonstrate and teach, which period shall not exceed 30 days.

cross_profession_credit_available.quote: A person who is certified to practice hair design or barbering under this section is authorized to practice natural hair care.

tanning_equipment_regulated.quote: Persons performing spray tanning services using a handheld airbrush tanning device that applies to another individual, without physical contact, a spray tanning solution that may include, but is not limited to, products containing dihydroxyacetone.
